name: Gravel Calculator
description: Calculate how much gravel you need for driveways, walkways, and landscaping. Enter area and depth for instant tons and cubic yards.
inputs: Length (feet), width (feet), depth (inches), gravel type (pea gravel, crushed stone, river rock)
formula: Volume (cubic feet) = length * width * (depth/12). Cubic yards = cubic feet / 27. Tons = cubic yards * 1.4 (varies by type).

name: Asphalt Calculator
description: Calculate tons of asphalt needed for driveways and parking lots. Enter area and thickness for accurate material estimates.
inputs: Length (feet), width (feet), thickness (inches)
formula: Volume (cubic feet) = length * width * (thickness/12). Tons = cubic feet * 0.145 (hot mix asphalt density).

name: Board Foot Calculator
description: Calculate board feet for lumber purchases. Enter thickness, width, length, and quantity to get total board feet and cost.
inputs: Thickness (inches), width (inches), length (feet), quantity, price per board foot
formula: Board feet = (thickness * width * length) / 12. Total = board feet * quantity. Cost = total * price per board foot.

name: Deck Calculator
description: Calculate deck boards, joists, and posts needed for your deck project. Enter dimensions to get a complete material list.
inputs: Deck length (feet), deck width (feet), board width (inches), joist spacing (inches)
formula: Deck area = length * width. Boards = deck area / ((board_width/12) * length_of_deck). Joists = length / (joist_spacing/12) + 1.

name: Fence Calculator
description: Calculate fence posts, rails, and pickets needed for any fence project. Supports wood, vinyl, and chain link.
inputs: Total fence length (feet), fence height (feet), post spacing (feet), fence type
formula: Posts = ceil(length / post_spacing) + 1. Rails = posts * (height / 8). Pickets = length * 12 / picket_width (for picket fences).

name: Drywall Calculator
description: Calculate drywall sheets, screws, and joint compound needed for any room. Enter dimensions for complete material list.
inputs: Room length (feet), room width (feet), ceiling height (feet), include ceiling (yes/no)
formula: Wall area = 2 * (length + width) * height. Ceiling area = length * width if included. Sheets = ceil(total_area / 32). Screws = sheets * 32. Mud = sheets * 4.5 lbs.

name: Insulation Calculator
description: Calculate insulation needed for walls, ceilings, and attics. Enter area and R-value target for bag or roll estimates.
inputs: Area (square feet), insulation type (fiberglass batts, blown-in, spray foam), R-value target
formula: Rolls for batts = ceil(area / coverage_per_roll). For blown-in: bags = ceil(area * R_value / bag_coverage_factor).

name: Mulch Calculator
description: Calculate how many bags or cubic yards of mulch you need for garden beds and landscaping.
inputs: Bed length (feet), bed width (feet), mulch depth (inches), bag size (cubic feet)
formula: Volume (cubic feet) = length * width * (depth/12). Cubic yards = cubic feet / 27. Bags = ceil(cubic feet / bag_size).

name: Concrete Steps Calculator
description: Calculate concrete volume and bag count for outdoor steps and stairways. Enter rise, run, and width for instant estimates.
inputs: Number of steps, rise per step (inches), run per step (inches), step width (feet)
formula: Volume per step = (width) * (run/12) * (rise/12). Total volume = sum across all steps using average rise. Cubic yards = cubic feet / 27.

name: Concrete Block Calculator
description: Calculate how many concrete blocks (CMUs) you need for any wall. Includes mortar and block count with waste factor.
inputs: Wall length (feet), wall height (feet), block size (8x8x16 or 8x4x16), waste percentage
formula: Wall area = length * height. Block face area = block length * block height / 144. Blocks = ceil(wall_area / block_face_area * (1 + waste/100)).

name: Concrete Mix Ratio Calculator
description: Calculate cement, sand, and aggregate quantities for custom concrete mixes. Choose your PSI target and get exact ratios.
inputs: Total volume (cubic feet), target PSI (2500, 3000, 3500, 4000)
formula: For 3000 PSI: cement = volume * 6 bags/cu yd. Sand = cement * 2. Aggregate = cement * 3. Water = cement * 0.5. Adjust ratios by PSI target.

name: Mortar Calculator
description: Calculate mortar needed for bricklaying, block walls, and stone work. Enter wall dimensions for accurate bag counts.
inputs: Wall area (square feet), block/brick type, mortar joint thickness (inches)
formula: Mortar volume = wall_area * joint_thickness / 12 * coverage_factor. Bags = ceil(mortar_volume / 0.7 cu ft per 80-lb bag).

name: Brick Calculator
description: Calculate how many bricks you need for walls, patios, or veneer. Includes standard brick sizes and waste factor.
inputs: Wall length (feet), wall height (feet), brick size (modular, queen, king, closure), waste percentage
formula: Wall area (sq in) = length * height * 144. Bricks per sq ft = 144 / ((brick_length + joint) * (brick_height + joint)). Total = ceil(wall_sqft * bricks_per_sqft * (1 + waste/100)).

name: Roof Area Calculator
description: Calculate the actual surface area of your roof from footprint and pitch. Essential for ordering materials accurately.
inputs: Building length (feet), building width (feet), roof pitch (X:12)
formula: Footprint = length * width. Pitch multiplier = sqrt(1 + (rise/12)^2). Roof area = footprint * pitch multiplier. Add 5% for waste.

name: Gutter Calculator
description: Calculate gutter length, downspouts, and hangers needed for your home. Enter roof edges and roof area.
inputs: Eave length (feet), number of downspout locations, gutter size, roof area (sq ft)
formula: Total gutter = eave_length. Downspouts = number_locations * (wall_height / 10). Hangers = ceil(eave_length / 2).

name: Roof Truss Calculator
description: Calculate the number of roof trusses needed and spacing for your building. For gable, hip, and shed roofs.
inputs: Building length (feet), roof type (gable, hip, shed), truss spacing (16, 24 inches)
formula: Number of trusses = ceil(building_length * 12 / truss_spacing) + 1. Add one truss per gable end if applicable.

name: Ridge Vent Calculator
description: Calculate linear feet of ridge vent needed for proper attic ventilation. Ensures code-compliant airflow.
inputs: Attic floor area (square feet), roof pitch
formula: Required net free area = attic_area / 150. Ridge vent length = required_NFA / 18 sq in per linear foot.

name: Vinyl Siding Calculator
description: Calculate vinyl siding squares, starter strips, and trim needed. Enter wall dimensions for complete material list.
inputs: Wall length (feet), wall height (feet), number of walls, number of windows, number of doors
formula: Wall area = length * height * number_of_walls. Subtract 15 sq ft per window and 20 sq ft per door. Siding squares = net_area / 100 * 1.1.

name: Hardie Plank Calculator
description: Calculate fiber cement siding boards needed for your project. Includes starter strips and trim allowance.
inputs: Wall area (square feet), board width (inches), board length (feet), overlap (inches)
formula: Coverage per board = board_length * (board_width - overlap) / 12. Boards = ceil(wall_area / coverage_per_board * 1.1).

name: Hardwood Flooring Calculator
description: Calculate square feet of hardwood flooring needed for any room. Includes waste factor and box count.
inputs: Room length (feet), room width (feet), waste percentage, box coverage (square feet)
formula: Area = length * width. Total with waste = area * (1 + waste/100). Boxes = ceil(total / box_coverage).

name: Laminate Flooring Calculator
description: Calculate laminate planks and boxes for your room. Includes underlayment and transition strips.
inputs: Room length (feet), room width (feet), plank dimensions (inches), waste percentage
formula: Area = length * width. Plank coverage = plank_length * plank_width / 144. Planks = ceil(area / plank_coverage * (1 + waste/100)).

name: Carpet Calculator
description: Calculate carpet square yards and padding needed for any room. Account for seams and directional layout.
inputs: Room length (feet), room width (feet), carpet roll width (12 or 15 feet)
formula: Area (sq yd) = length * width / 9. Add 10% for seams and waste. Padding = area + 5%.

name: Grout Calculator
description: Calculate grout needed for tile installations. Enter tile size and joint width for accurate bag count.
inputs: Tile area (square feet), tile length (inches), tile width (inches), joint width (inches), tile thickness (inches)
formula: Grout volume per sq ft = ((tile_length + tile_width) / (tile_length * tile_width)) * joint_width * tile_thickness. Bags = ceil(total / coverage_per_bag).

name: Thinset Calculator
description: Calculate thinset mortar needed for tile installation. Choose trowel size and tile format for accurate coverage.
inputs: Tile area (square feet), trowel size (1/4, 3/8, 1/2 inch), tile type (standard, large format, stone)
formula: Coverage per 50-lb bag: 1/4 inch = 90 sq ft, 3/8 inch = 60 sq ft, 1/2 inch = 40 sq ft. Large format reduces 20%. Bags = ceil(area / coverage).

name: Backsplash Calculator
description: Calculate tile needed for a kitchen backsplash. Account for outlets, windows, and tile size.
inputs: Counter length (feet), backsplash height (inches), number of outlets, tile size (inches)
formula: Area (sq in) = counter_length * 12 * backsplash_height. Subtract 30 sq in per outlet. Tiles = ceil(area / tile_area * 1.1).

name: Wallpaper Calculator
description: Calculate wallpaper rolls needed for any room. Enter wall dimensions and pattern repeat for accuracy.
inputs: Room length (feet), room width (feet), ceiling height (feet), pattern repeat (inches), windows and doors count
formula: Wall area = 2 * (length + width) * height. Subtract doors and windows. Rolls = ceil(wall_area / usable_area_per_roll).

name: Wall Area Calculator
description: Calculate total wall area for painting, wallpaper, or siding. Subtract doors and windows automatically.
inputs: Room length (feet), room width (feet), ceiling height (feet), number of doors, number of windows
formula: Perimeter = 2 * (length + width). Gross wall area = perimeter * height. Subtract 20 sq ft per door and 15 sq ft per window.

name: Drywall Mud Calculator
description: Calculate joint compound needed for a drywall project. Includes taping, filling, and finishing coats.
inputs: Number of drywall sheets, level of finish (Level 3, 4, or 5)
formula: Level 3: 2 lbs per sheet. Level 4: 4 lbs per sheet. Level 5: 6 lbs per sheet. Buckets of 4.5 gallons weigh ~55 lbs.

name: Drywall Screws Calculator
description: Calculate how many drywall screws you need. Based on sheet count, stud spacing, and screw pattern.
inputs: Number of drywall sheets, stud spacing (16 or 24 inches), screw pattern (standard, ceiling, fire-rated)
formula: Standard on 16-inch studs: 32 screws per 4x8 sheet. Ceiling pattern: 40 per sheet. Fire-rated: 60 per sheet. Total = sheets * count.

name: Drywall Corner Bead Calculator
description: Calculate linear feet of corner bead needed for your drywall project. Includes inside and outside corners.
inputs: Number of outside corners, number of inside corners, average corner height (feet)
formula: Outside corner bead = number_of_outside * corner_height. Add 5% waste for cuts.

name: AC Unit Size Calculator
description: Calculate the correct AC tonnage for any room. Based on square footage, climate, and insulation.
inputs: Room length (feet), room width (feet), ceiling height (feet), climate zone, insulation quality
formula: BTU base = length * width * 25. Adjust for sun, occupants, ceiling height. Tons = BTU / 12000.

name: BTU Calculator
description: Calculate heating and cooling BTUs needed for any space. Essential for sizing HVAC equipment correctly.
inputs: Room length (feet), room width (feet), ceiling height (feet), insulation level, climate
formula: Cooling BTU = area * 25 + adjustments. Heating BTU = area * 45 * climate_factor * insulation_factor.

name: Furnace Size Calculator
description: Calculate the correct furnace size for your home. Based on square footage, climate, and insulation.
inputs: Home square footage, climate zone, insulation quality, ceiling height
formula: Output BTU = square_footage * 35 * climate_multiplier * insulation_factor. Furnace input = output / AFUE.

name: Duct Size Calculator
description: Calculate proper duct size for HVAC airflow. Enter CFM and friction rate for correct diameter.
inputs: Required CFM, friction rate (inches of water per 100 ft)
formula: Approximate: duct_diameter (inches) = 2 * sqrt(CFM / (velocity * pi / 144)). Target velocity: 700-900 fpm for trunk, 500-700 for branches.

name: Electrical Load Calculator
description: Calculate the electrical load for a home or addition. Determines service panel requirements.
inputs: Square footage, number of small appliance circuits, number of laundry circuits, large appliances kW
formula: General lighting = 3 watts per sq ft. Small appliance circuits: 1500 VA each. Laundry: 1500 VA. Apply demand factors. Total / 240 = amps.

name: Wire Size Calculator
description: Calculate the correct wire gauge for electrical runs. Based on amperage, distance, and voltage drop.
inputs: Amperage, distance (feet), voltage (120 or 240), allowable voltage drop (3% typical)
formula: Use NEC ampacity charts for base size. For voltage drop over 50 ft: wire_size = 2 * length * amperage * resistivity / allowable_drop. Round up.

name: Breaker Size Calculator
description: Calculate the correct circuit breaker size for any load. Follows NEC continuous load rules.
inputs: Load in watts or amps, voltage, continuous or non-continuous load
formula: Amps = watts / voltage. For continuous loads, multiply by 1.25. Round up to next standard breaker: 15, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100.

name: Outlet Spacing Calculator
description: Calculate number of electrical outlets needed per room. Follows NEC spacing requirements.
inputs: Room length (feet), room width (feet), room type (kitchen, bedroom, living room, bathroom)
formula: NEC rule: no point along wall more than 6 feet from an outlet. Outlets = ceil(perimeter / 12). Kitchen counters: every 4 ft. Bathrooms: one per sink plus GFCI.

name: Shower Tile Calculator
description: Calculate tiles and materials needed for a shower surround. Account for niches and benches.
inputs: Shower length (feet), shower width (feet), shower height (feet), number of niches, tile size (inches)
formula: Wall area = 2 * (length + width) * height. Add 6 sq ft per niche. Tiles = ceil(wall_area / tile_area * 1.15).

name: Bathroom Floor Tile Calculator
description: Calculate floor tile needed for a bathroom. Account for toilet, vanity, and tub cutouts.
inputs: Bathroom length (feet), bathroom width (feet), tile size (inches), waste percentage
formula: Area = length * width. Add 10% waste. Tiles = ceil(area * 1.1 / (tile_size^2 / 144)).

name: Kitchen Floor Calculator
description: Calculate kitchen floor tile or vinyl needed. Subtract cabinet footprints for accuracy.
inputs: Kitchen length (feet), kitchen width (feet), cabinet footprint (square feet), flooring type
formula: Area = length * width - cabinet_footprint. Add 10% waste.

name: Paver Calculator
description: Calculate pavers needed for patios, driveways, and walkways. Includes base material and sand.
inputs: Patio length (feet), patio width (feet), paver size (square inches), base depth (inches)
formula: Area = length * width. Pavers = ceil(area * 144 / paver_size * 1.05). Base cubic yards = area * (base_depth/12) / 27.

name: Retaining Wall Calculator
description: Calculate blocks, caps, gravel, and drainage for a retaining wall. Ensures proper structural design.
inputs: Wall length (feet), wall height (feet), block size (square inches of face), wall type
formula: Wall face area = length * height. Blocks = ceil(wall_face_area * 144 / block_face_area * 1.05). Cap blocks = ceil(length / cap_length).

name: Artificial Turf Calculator
description: Calculate artificial grass needed for lawns and play areas. Includes base material and seaming.
inputs: Lawn length (feet), lawn width (feet), roll width (feet), waste percentage
formula: Area = length * width. Rolls = ceil(area / roll_coverage). Add 5% for seams. Base gravel: 3 inches = 0.25 cu yd per sq ft.

name: Sod Calculator
description: Calculate sod rolls or pallets needed for a new lawn. Includes soil prep and starter fertilizer.
inputs: Lawn length (feet), lawn width (feet), sod roll size (square feet)
formula: Area = length * width. Sod rolls = ceil(area / roll_size). Pallets typically hold 450-500 sq ft.

name: Topsoil Calculator
description: Calculate how much topsoil you need for lawns, gardens, and raised beds. Enter area and depth.
inputs: Length (feet), width (feet), depth (inches), measurement unit
formula: Volume (cubic feet) = length * width * (depth/12). Cubic yards = cubic feet / 27. Bags (40 lb) = ceil(cubic_feet / 0.75).

name: Compost Calculator
description: Calculate how much compost to add to garden beds and lawns. Includes application rate recommendations.
inputs: Garden area (square feet), application rate (inches), compost type
formula: Volume (cubic feet) = area * (rate/12). Cubic yards = volume / 27.

name: Fertilizer Calculator
description: Calculate fertilizer needed based on NPK ratio and target nitrogen per 1000 sq ft. Essential for lawns.
inputs: Lawn area (square feet), desired nitrogen per 1000 sq ft (lbs), fertilizer NPK ratio
formula: Total nitrogen = area / 1000 * N_per_1000. Fertilizer weight = nitrogen / (N_percentage / 100).

name: Grass Seed Calculator
description: Calculate grass seed needed for new lawns or overseeding. Varies by grass type and application.
inputs: Lawn area (square feet), grass type, application (new lawn or overseed)
formula: New lawn: 4-6 lbs per 1000 sq ft. Overseed: 2-3 lbs per 1000 sq ft. Total = area / 1000 * rate * 1.1.

name: Chain Link Fence Calculator
description: Calculate chain link fence materials: fabric, posts, rails, and tension wire. Complete list for any length.
inputs: Total fence length (feet), fence height (feet), post spacing (feet)
formula: Line posts = ceil(length / post_spacing) + 1. Top rail = length + 5%. Fabric = length * 1.05. Tension wire = length + 10%.

name: Privacy Fence Calculator
description: Calculate wood privacy fence materials: pickets, rails, posts, and concrete. For dog-ear, board-on-board, or shadowbox.
inputs: Total fence length (feet), fence height (feet), picket width (inches), post spacing (feet)
formula: Pickets = ceil(length * 12 / (picket_width + gap)). Posts = ceil(length / post_spacing) + 1. Rails = posts * (height == 6 ? 3 : 2).

name: Fence Gate Calculator
description: Calculate materials for a wood fence gate. Includes frame, pickets, hinges, and latch hardware.
inputs: Gate width (feet), gate height (feet), gate style (single, double, walk-through)
formula: Pickets = ceil(gate_width * 12 / (picket_width + gap)). Hinges: 2 per gate. Latch: 1 per gate.

name: Deck Board Calculator
description: Calculate deck boards needed for your deck surface. Includes gap allowance and waste factor.
inputs: Deck length (feet), deck width (feet), board width (inches), board length (feet), gap between boards (inches)
formula: Board coverage = (board_width + gap) / 12. Boards = ceil(deck_length / board_coverage) * ceil(deck_width / board_length). Add 10% waste.

name: Deck Railing Calculator
description: Calculate deck railing materials: posts, top rail, bottom rail, balusters, and hardware.
inputs: Total railing length (feet), railing height (feet), post spacing (feet), baluster spacing (inches)
formula: Railing posts = ceil(length / post_spacing) + 1. Balusters = ceil(length * 12 / (baluster_width + gap)). Top and bottom rail = length + 5%.

name: Deck Stair Calculator
description: Calculate stair stringers, treads, and risers for deck stairs. Ensures code-compliant dimensions.
inputs: Total rise (inches), total run (inches), desired tread depth (inches), stair width (feet)
formula: Risers = ceil(total_rise / 7.5). Total run = (risers - 1) * tread_depth. Stringers = ceil(stair_width / 16).

name: Concrete Footing Size Calculator
description: Determine proper footing dimensions based on load, soil bearing capacity, and building code.
inputs: Load in pounds, soil bearing capacity (psf), footing type
formula: Required footing area = load / soil_bearing_capacity. For square pad: side = sqrt(area). Depth: 12 inches minimum below frost line.

name: Load Bearing Calculator
description: Calculate load on a beam or wall based on floor area supported. Ensures structural beams are properly sized.
inputs: Floor area supported (square feet), floor type, joist spacing (inches)
formula: Live load: 40 psf living, 125 psf storage. Dead load: 10 psf. Total = area * (live + dead).
